body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics has announced that it plans to release its new MP3P ‘YH-J50’ which employs 1-inch micro-drive. It features 1.5-inch TFT-LCD and plays various file formats: MP3, WMA, WAV, OGG, MPEG4. with USB-host functionality, you can transmit data stored other digital devices anywhere without pc. It runs for 18 hours and comes up in two type:6G and 8G. <AVING Special Report Team for ‘KES2005’ : Editor&Publisher, Jason Lee, Joshua Shim, Nikki Whang, Sheri Choi, Sophia Kwag, Annie Park, Caleb Ma, edited by Daniel Sirh>
